For an astronomer, this instrument is not merely a tool but a sophisticated optical system designed to gather and concentrate light. The process begins with the lenses, typically crafted from high-quality glass, which are housed within the sturdy brass tube. These lenses work in tandem to refract incoming light, bending it to a specific convergence point.

The art of observation relies heavily on precise focusing
